examples.scenario: A parcel edge passes through a pixel center and default behavior is used without a declared rule
examples.reason: GDAL documents this exact-touch case as unspecified.

examples.scenario: ALL_TOUCHED adds a high-elevation corner cell excluded by center-only support
examples.reason: Changing support semantics can change extrema.

examples.scenario: Two overlapping features burn different values and their source order changes
examples.reason: The last processed feature can determine the pixel value.

examples.scenario: Rasterio False values inside the parcel are interpreted as rejected cells
examples.reason: Default polarity is opposite to many accepted-cell conventions.

examples.scenario: An invalid parcel ring is skipped with a warning
examples.reason: Omitting the target parcel cannot produce a defensible mask.

examples.scenario: A polygon hole contains a low DEM cell but the interior ring is dropped
examples.reason: Hole cells are outside the polygon surface.

examples.scenario: A pixel center lies exactly on the parcel boundary
examples.reason: Boundary predicates differ and must be explicit.

examples.scenario: Crop padding adds neighboring pixels to the read window
examples.reason: Padding must not expand exact parcel support.
